packageRules.description: Batch all patch updates into one weekly PR and let Renovate merge it once every status check (including the Vercel deployment) is green. Each Renovate rebase costs a Vercel build on the free tier, so one grouped branch per week replaces the manual batching done in #295. minimumReleaseAge gives the registry time to pull a bad or compromised release before it can land unattended.
Batch minor updates into one weekly PR for manual review.

Gate katex major and minor updates behind Dependency Dashboard approval. rehype-katex@7 and micromark-extension-math@3 both depend on katex ^0.16.0, so bumping the root dep only swaps the stylesheet while 0.16 still renders the markup. KaTeX 0.18 changed its CSS classes, so the two drift apart and the build's rendering check fails (see #277). Minor is included because Renovate classifies 0.x bumps such as 0.16 -> 0.19 as minor, which let #290 through a major-only rule. Approve this only in a PR that also moves rehype-katex/remark-math to releases supporting the new KaTeX. Kept last so it overrides the grouping rules above.
